lines.text: Many learners say: We all are students.
The second! We are all friends.

native.hook: “我们都是”要说 We are all！
native.tip: 中文说“我们都是”，“都”放在“是”前面。英语里 all 通常放在 are 后面，说 “We are all”。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “We all are students.”😅 英语里 all 通常放在 are 后面：“We are all students.”跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“We are all students.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: Chinese puts “all” before the verb, but English usually puts “all” after “are.”
en.caption: Do you say “We all are students.” 😅 In English, “all” usually comes after “are”: “We are all students.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
